body:
Adds **CHOPPAH** to the FM-1 list.

CHOPPAH is a breakbeat chopper for the M-VAVE FM-1: eight Amen-family breaks built into the flash, sixteen slices per break, and a four-slot FX chain (filter, bit crusher, drive, transient shaper) with reverb, delay and a mix bus on top.

- Repository: https://github.com/profikid/fm1-break-choppah
- License: MPL-2.0
- Built on: fm1-base

The list already carries the other FM-1 firmwares (SLOOP, Felucca, X0X, FoMni, AMB-1, ChoralRoot, Polly, ...), so this seemed the natural place for it.

It also fixes the recent UC25HQ80 flash issue on the newer AliExpress units - firmwares without that fix cannot be installed on those units at all.
